Isaiah Hartenstein is 28 years old.

Isaiah Hartenstein was born in Eugene, Oregon.

Isaiah Hartenstein is 7-0 (213 cm) tall.

Isaiah Hartenstein weighs 250 lbs (113 kg).

Isaiah Hartenstein is not in the Hall of Fame.

Center and Power Forward.

Isaiah Hartenstein has won one championship.
